llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must wrap the form screen with `KeyboardProvider` and render form content in `KeyboardAwareScrollView` from `react-native-keyboard-controller`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: KeyboardProvider is present, but the form content is rendered in a plain ScrollView, not KeyboardAwareScrollView from react-native-keyboard-controller.
keyboardDismissMode="interactive" is set, but on a plain ScrollView, not on KeyboardAwareScrollView as required.
keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" is set, but on a plain ScrollView, not on KeyboardAwareScrollView as required.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use `useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation` with Reanimated `useAnimatedStyle` to drive footer `translateY` from `-keyboard.height.value`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation is never imported or called; the code uses useKeyboardAnimation instead. The translateY derivation also contains a bug (double .value access) and does not follow the required pattern of -keyboard.height.value.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use Reanimated `interpolate` over `keyboard.progress.value` to animate footer bottom padding during keyboard transitions.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: There is no use of keyboard.progress.value (from useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation) with interpolate to animate footer bottom padding. The footer style only animates translateY and has no dynamic paddingBottom.
